mapper.select: select distinct a.PRJ_ID as prjId,b.NAME as prjName, a.STAGE_ID as stageId,c.NAME as stageName, a.SUB_ITEM_ID as subItemId,d.NAME as subItemName, a.PROFESSION_ID as professionId,e.NAME as professionName, c.SORT_INDEX as stageIndex,e.SORT_INDEX as professionIndex from BIZ_CAD_PRODUCT a LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROJECT b on b.ID = a.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE c on c.ID = a.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM d on d.ID = a.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION e on e.ID = a.PROFESSION_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
